Canada-NBC-problems.json.verification_notes: The National Biology Competition of the University of Toronto (Canada), one record per multiple-choice question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official exam paper published on the competition site and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or answer keys. The questions remain the work of the University of Toronto National Biology Competition.

IBO-practical-problems.json.verification_notes: Practical exams, one record per printed part or task with its protocol, data, figures and every question, transcribed from the official English paper of the IBO examination papers archive and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers, answer keys or marking schemes. IBO examination papers © International Biology Olympiad, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
